question: The heights of two cones are in the ratio 7 ∶ 5 and their diameters are in the ratio 10 ∶ 21. What is the ratio of their volumes? (Where π = (22)/(7))
solution: Given: If the heights of two cones are in the ratio of 7 ∶ 5 and their diameters are in the ratio 10 ∶ 21. Formula Used: The volume of cone = dfrac{1}{3} × pi × r² × h Calculation: ⇒ The heights of two cones are in the ratio 7 ∶ 5. ⇒ The diameters are in the ratio 10 ∶ 21. The ratio of their volume : ⇒ V1 : V2 ⇒ dfrac{1}{3} × pi × r₁² × h₁ : dfrac{1}{3} pi × {r₂²} × h₂ ⇒ (dfrac{10}{2})² × 7 : (dfrac{21}{2})² ×5 ⇒ 100 × 7 : 441 × 5 ⇒ 20 : 63 So, the ratio of their volumes will be 20 : 63. 9d:Tab6,
